Why do we miss the red flags, stay too long, or make the same mistakes over and over? The truth is, we aren't stupid—we are profoundly unprepared. Society expects us to master one of the most complex human arts with zero practice, zero training, and just a handful of partners before we're expected to make life-altering decisions.
